description: On the yellow tabletop in front of you are a white AirPods charging case and two loose AirPods. The left hand moves in to steady and open the case, while the right hand picks up one AirPod from the table and places it into the open case; then the right hand brings the other AirPod over and drops it into the case as the left hand closes it, leaving the closed case on the table with both hands released.
